name: opendental
description: Connect Claude to Open Dental: schedule, patients, A/R, claims and production reports. Independent project, not affiliated with Open Dental Software.
long_description: Reads your Open Dental database through the official Open Dental API (cloud, API Service or Local API). Read-only unless you turn on "Allow changes", which lets Claude book, move, confirm or break appointments and add commlog and appointment notes after you approve each one. SSNs are removed from every result, and report queries are limited to read-only SQL.

tools.name: od_connection_check
tools.description: Test the connection and show settings

tools.name: od_get_appointments
tools.description: List appointments by date or patient

tools.name: od_add_appointment_note
tools.description: Add to an appointment note (needs Allow changes)

developer_key.title: Developer Key
developer_key.description: From the Open Dental Developer Portal.

customer_key.title: Customer Key
customer_key.description: Your office's key, also entered in Open Dental under Setup > Advanced Setup > API.

base_url.title: API URL
base_url.description: In the office: http://<server IP>:30223/api/v1 (API Service). Outside the office: https://api.opendental.com/api/v1 (cloud).

allow_writes.title: Allow changes
allow_writes.description: Let Claude book, move, confirm or break appointments and add notes. Claude asks before each change.

max_rows.title: Max rows per request
max_rows.description: Upper limit on rows returned by one tool call.
